highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 removes the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 blocker for dependent applications.

bullets.detail: Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

v4.151.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 removes the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 blocker for dependent applications.
